newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain-Corn and soy mixed, SRW wheat lower.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain-Corn and soy mixed, SRW wheat lower.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn and soybean prices were mixed on Monday in lackluster activity, grain dealers said.
Soft red winter wheat offers fell seven to eight cents a bushel while hard red winter wheat was steady.
In export news, Slovenia was expected early this week to tender for 40,000 to 50,000 tonnes of Canadian or U.S. wheat, U.S. exporters said.
Also, Cargill Inc said it received approval from the U.S. Treasury Department to export up to 500,000 tonnes of grains to North Korea.
